context: Teacher (asuka) and student (ren) watch and analyze a TV crime-news segment about a murder investigation
purpose: Teach: 刑事/殺し/侵害/違法/正当/権限/戦闘/馬鹿

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: このニュース、見てください。担当の刑事が会見していますね。
lines.en: Take a look at this news segment. The detective in charge is giving a press conference.
lines.style: composed teacher cueing a focused classroom analysis

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 殺しの容疑で逮捕、って出てますね。結構生々しい事件ですね。
lines.en: It says he was arrested on suspicion of murder. Pretty grisly case, huh.
lines.style: university student squinting at the screen, half uneasy

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: そうですね。警察にも捜査する権限はありますが、無制限ではありません。
lines.en: Indeed. The police have authority to investigate, but it isn't unlimited.
lines.style: teacher pivoting smoothly into a legal lecture

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: えっと、令状なしで家に踏み込んだら、それって人権侵害になるんですか?
lines.en: Uh, if they barge into the house without a warrant, does that count as a human rights violation?
lines.style: earnest student testing a hypothesis aloud

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 良い質問です。手続きを無視すれば違法捜査になり、証拠も無効になり得ます。
lines.en: Good question. If they skip procedure it becomes an illegal search, and the evidence can be thrown out.
lines.style: patient teacher praising while tightening the logic

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: でも犯人が抵抗して戦闘みたいになったら、撃つのは正当防衛ですよね?
lines.en: But if the suspect resists and it turns into a full-on fight, shooting him is legitimate self-defense, right?
lines.style: student leaning forward, working through tricky edge cases aloud

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 単純に馬鹿正直に撃ってよいわけではなく、必要最小限であることが条件です。
lines.en: You can't just naively open fire — it has to be the minimum force necessary.
lines.style: teacher gently correcting the student's oversimplified assumption with care

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: なるほど。刑事ドラマみたいにバンバン撃ってたら、現実なら大問題ですね。
lines.en: I see. If they were blasting away like in a TV cop drama, in real life that'd be a huge problem.
lines.style: student exhaling, the lesson finally clicking into place
